scope: 0.10.1-claudegpt.29: the background-work rule of .28 also with an older PTY host. When the attached host advertises a sessions service below version 2, SessionManager applies the rule to the statuses that host reports: an idle status with notify done for a claude with tool shells (pid known here: registry/launched pid or the spawned pid; WSL not checked) becomes background with the done held back, and such sessions join the 20 s recheck, which announces done and idle once no tool shell is left. Later busy/waiting/ended from the host end the wait as before. Hosts with sessions version 2 unchanged. Unit test in src/main/ptyhost-client.test.ts with a fake sessions-v1 host and a stubbed tool-shell check.
